title: Prior-dependent neural timing representations
scientific_question: Over verified common sampled-interval support, do short and long prior contexts differ in a prespecified retrospective Set–Go neural-trajectory contrast after response-modality/direction and temporal-block controls, and what within-session uncertainty supports that conclusion?
primary_outputs: An independently recomputed matched-prior difference in measured response-conditioned neural trajectories on the complete prespecified eligible interval/modality/direction/block support, together with its support and within-session uncertainty. The contrast may be null, reversed or unsupported; its empirical value is not supplied by the paper narrative. The exact full-trajectory packet, basis and reference remain unqualified.
